'''Jude Navarro''' is an [[Engineers|Odyssey Engineer]] based at '''Marshall's Drift''' in the '''Aurai''' system. A former militia fighter forced to retire after being injured in combat, he now applies his engineering experience to combat-oriented suits and handheld weapons.<ref name="inara-jude">[https://inara.cz/elite/engineer/26/ Jude Navarro — Engineer], INARA; current access, location, services, and referral record. Retrieved 12 September 2026.</ref><ref name="fandom-jude">[https://elite-dangerous.fandom.com/wiki/Jude_Navarro Jude Navarro], Elite Dangerous Wiki; in-game biography. Retrieved 12 September 2026.</ref>

Jude is one of the independent starting Engineers in the Bubble and opens the referral branch leading to [[Terra Velasquez]].

Marshall's Drift is a surface Engineer base on Aurai 1 a, approximately 1,614 Ls from the system arrival point.<ref name="inara-marshalls-drift">[https://inara.cz/elite/station/241978/ Marshall's Drift — Station], INARA; current facility and location record. Retrieved 12 September 2026.</ref>

== Access requirements ==

{| class="wikitable"
! Stage
! Requirement
|-
| Discovery
| '''Common knowledge.''' Jude does not require a referral from another Engineer.
|-
| Unlock
| Complete '''10 Restore or Reactivation missions'''.

The qualifying missions must be completed; restoring power at an unrelated abandoned settlement is not itself the documented requirement. The mission workflow and settlement preparation belong to [[Unlocking Jude Navarro]].<ref name="inara-jude" />

{{Field note|INARA reports that station services may not appear immediately after the workshop is unlocked. Relogging should make them available.<ref name="inara-jude" />}}

== Odyssey Engineering ==

Jude installs individual modifications into available suit and handheld-weapon modification slots. His services do not use the Grade 1–5 Engineer-reputation progression, blueprint rolls, Experimental Effects, or Remote Engineering used for ship modules. Equipment grade and modification-slot availability are handled through the wider [[Odyssey Engineering]] system.

== Engineering services ==

{| class="wikitable sortable"
! Modification
! Equipment
! Purpose

| Suit

|-
| Magazine Size
| Handheld weapon
| Increases the weapon's magazine capacity.
|-
| Reload Speed
| Handheld weapon
| Shortens weapon reload time.

These five modification types are available once Jude is unlocked, subject to compatible equipment, an open modification slot, and the required Odyssey materials and credits.<ref name="inara-jude" /> Their complete recipes and cross-Engineer availability belong to [[Odyssey Engineer Modifications]].

== Referral to Terra Velasquez ==

After unlocking Jude, provide him with '''5 Genetic Repair Meds''' to discover [[Terra Velasquez]]. These goods are the referral requirement and are separate from the ten missions required to unlock Jude himself.<ref name="inara-jude" /><ref name="inara-terra">[https://inara.cz/elite/engineer/31/ Terra Velasquez — Engineer], INARA; current discovery prerequisite. Retrieved 12 September 2026.</ref>

<pre>
Jude Navarro
└── Terra Velasquez
</pre>

Terra's own unlock conditions belong on [[Terra Velasquez]] and in [[Unlocking Terra Velasquez]].
